clips.title: Are We Doing Something Wrong?
grammar: 〜てるところ — in the middle of doing

lines.ja: 名前覚えとるとこやね。
lines.en: I was just trying to remember your name.
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.en: Hey, what are you going to do, Kai?
lines.speaker: Akimi

lines.ja: なんか悪いことしてる？
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.en: What will you do in Tokyo?
lines.speaker: Akimi

lines.en: Make it big as a manga artist.
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.en: Tell me not to go home.
lines.speaker: Akimi

lines.ja: そしたら私、バカになれるから。
lines.en: Because then, I can just act like a fool.
lines.speaker: Akimi

clips.title: Walking Together
grammar: 〜かわからない — don't know whether

lines.ja: どこまで続くか分からない。
lines.en: I don't know how long it will last.
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.ja: けれど、続くところまで共に歩きたい。
lines.en: Yet, I want to walk together for as long as it does.
lines.speaker: Kai

lines.ja: もっと一緒にいれるって思ってたんやけど…
lines.en: I thought we'd be able to stay together longer, but...
lines.speaker: Akimi
